reasons.persona_fit: Directly addresses small-business owners in a calm, technically grounded voice with zero hype, no sales CTA, and precise Bareni positioning.
reasons.clarity: Explains with clean logic why rollback plans fail to prevent blast radius and why upfront human control gates are needed.
reasons.actionability: Provides a practical, low-overhead exercise: list three failure modes, choose a gate before commitment, and spot-check inputs.
reasons.factual_grounding: Accurately represents Bareni's code handover and no-lock-in policies without exaggerating capabilities or claiming customer deployments.
